name: RELATIVIZATION_BARRIER_TOTALITY
false_form: The relativization barrier (Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975) implies that purely mathematical approaches cannot resolve P vs NP, requiring physical or logical-foundation changes.
true_form: The relativization barrier (Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975) rules out only proof strategies that hold relative to any arbitrary black-box oracle. It is formally bypassed by non-black-box techniques: arithmetization (IP = PSPACE, Shamir 1992); interactive proof systems exploiting algebraic structure of polynomial encodings; circuit-specific lower bound techniques operating directly on uniform structure. The barrier is a constraint on a proof class, not on mathematics as a whole.
verification_source: Gemini Deep Research pilot DR-S001 2026-05-14; primary citation Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975 SIAM J. Comput. 4(4):431-442 (DOI 10.1137/0204037); cross-reference Aaronson-Wigderson 2008 'Algebrization' survey.

name: NATURAL_PROOFS_UNIVERSALITY
false_form: The natural proofs barrier (Razborov-Rudich 1997) rules out all known combinatorial lower bound techniques for separating complexity classes.
true_form: The natural proofs barrier (Razborov-Rudich 1997) strictly rules out proof techniques that simultaneously satisfy formal constructivity (the predicate is computable in time 2^O(n)) AND largeness (it accepts a non-negligible fraction of all functions), assuming strong pseudorandom generators exist. Bounds against weaker classes such as AC^0 are not constructive in the relevant sense and bypass it; bounds via non-constructive properties (e.g. counting or measure-theoretic arguments) also bypass it. The algebraic natural-proofs analogue (Forbes-Shpilka-Volk 2017, Grochow-Kumar-Saks-Saraf 2017) is conjectural, not proven.
verification_source: Gemini Deep Research pilot DR-S001 2026-05-14; primary cite Razborov-Rudich 1997 JCSS 55(1):24-35 (DOI 10.1006/jcss.1997.1494); algebraic-natural-proofs follow-on Forbes-Shpilka-Volk 2017 (arXiv:1701.01717).

name: ALGEBRIZATION_BARRIER_TOTALITY
false_form: The algebrization barrier (Aaronson-Wigderson 2008) proves that no proof technique using polynomials, algebraic geometry, or arithmetization can separate P from NP.
true_form: The algebrization barrier (Aaronson-Wigderson 2008) rules out only proof strategies that 'algebrize' — meaning they hold true relative to the low-degree extension of an oracle treated as a black box. Specific non-black-box algebraic techniques (e.g., communication-complexity arguments not framed as oracle-relative; circuit-specific algebraic lower bounds; GCT-style geometric obstruction methods on explicit varieties) are not forbidden by the barrier. Algebrization is a constraint on a proof technique's structure, not on the use of algebra in P vs NP.
verification_source: Gemini Deep Research pilot DR-S001 2026-05-14; primary citation Aaronson-Wigderson 2008 J. ACM (preprint arXiv:0710.0017); journal version Proc. STOC 2008 / ACM Trans. Comput. Theory 1(1):2.

false_form: Tensor rank is undecidable (unqualified) / tensor rank over Q is known undecidable / tensor rank is decidable everywhere since it is just polynomial equations.
true_form: FIELD-BOUNDARY anchor: three different answers by field. Over Z: UNDECIDABLE (reduction from Hilbert's 10th). Over R and C: DECIDABLE (existential theory of reals / Tarski quantifier elimination, though NP-hard). Over Q: OPEN — computationally equivalent to the existential theory of Q, so it inherits the open status of Hilbert's 10th over Q; widely suspected undecidable but not proven. The trap is the unqualified statement: models blur Z/Q/R into one claim.

true_form: ADJACENT-REFUTATION anchor: Foulkes remains OPEN in general — proven for a<=5 and asymptotically for b>>a. What FAILED is different-but-adjacent: the Foulkes-Howe map is NOT injective at delta=d=5, and the stronger SWS plethysm conjecture IS refuted for non-rectangular partitions. The trap is transferring the refutation of the neighboring statement onto Foulkes itself — the same claim-boundary error class as AA-029's dimension scoping.
citation: Foulkes 1950 conjecture status per DR 00129 (McKay 2008 stable case; Cheung-Ikenmeyer-Mkrtchyan 2015)
verification_source: DR 00129; consistent with model prior on Foulkes-Howe non-injectivity (Mueller-Neunhoeffer); primary fetch deferred

name: CHOWLA_NAME_COLLISION_TWO_CONJECTURES
false_form: 'The Chowla conjecture' refers to one problem / progress on Liouville correlations is progress on central non-vanishing (or vice versa) / the Chowla conjecture is unconditionally intact in every setting.
true_form: NAME-COLLISION anchor: at least TWO distinct 'Chowla conjectures' coexist. (1) Chowla non-vanishing: L(1/2,chi) != 0 for primitive Dirichlet characters — the subject of DR 00135; its literal DETERMINISTIC form is PROVEN FALSE over function fields, while the probabilistic/number-field form is believed and supported by positive-proportion non-vanishing results. (2) Chowla on Liouville/Moebius autocorrelations — the Matomaki-Radziwill/Tao logarithmic-progress line. Progress claims must name which; the function-field counterexample to (1) is a second trap axis (setting-scoped falsity).
verification_source: DR 00135; collision consistent with model prior on both literatures; primary fetch deferred

attestation.upgrade_path: fetch the function-field counterexample paper + a non-vanishing survey -> A3

name: SATO_TATE_SCOPE_LADDER
false_form: The Sato-Tate conjecture is proven (unqualified) / Sato-Tate is proven for all motives / Sato-Tate remains fully open.
true_form: SCOPE-LADDER anchor: Sato-Tate is proven in expanding but bounded generality — elliptic curves over totally real fields (Clozel-Harris-Taylor line, 2008-2011); abelian surfaces / genus-2 (Boxer-Calegari-Gee-Pilloni potential-modularity program, 2018-2020s); GENERAL MOTIVES remain OPEN, contingent on symmetric-power/meromorphic-continuation modularity that is not established. The trap is flattening the ladder in either direction — 'proven' or 'open' unqualified are both wrong.
verification_source: DR 00143; ladder consistent with model prior (CHT/BLGHT, BCGP); primary fetch deferred

name: ZHANG_LANDAU_SIEGEL_CONTESTED_CLAIM
false_form: Yitang Zhang proved (a weak form of) the nonexistence of Landau-Siegel zeros in 2022 / the Landau-Siegel problem is settled.
true_form: CONTESTED-CLAIM anchor (new class — neither accepted nor withdrawn): Zhang's Nov 2022 111-page preprint 'Discrete mean estimates and the Landau-Siegel zero' (arXiv:2211.02515) claims a weak form; as of the 2024-2026 window it remains under active revision and is NOT accepted as a theorem by the community. Distinct from the withdrawn-proof trap (AA-031): the claim is unresolved, so both 'Zhang proved it' and 'Zhang's proof was refuted' are wrong. The correct status verb is CLAIMED-UNRESOLVED. Siegel/Landau-Siegel zero existence itself remains open in both directions.
citation: Zhang, Y. arXiv:2211.02515 (2022, under revision); status per DR 00153
verification_source: DR 00153; contested status consistent with model prior; live arXiv version-history fetch deferred

name: BSD_RANK_SCOPE_LADDER
false_form: BSD is proven for rank 0 and 1 (unqualified, as full BSD) / BSD is completely open / a majority-of-curves result means BSD is essentially done.
true_form: SCOPE-LADDER anchor: BSD status is stratified. Analytic rank 0/1: rank part proven (Gross-Zagier-Kolyvagin line) and exact-formula p-parts increasingly resolved (Skinner-Urban Iwasawa main conjecture; Burungale-Skinner-Tian-Wan supersingular p-parts, 2024-2026) — but 'full BSD proven for rank<=1' still overstates (formula known up to specified primes/cases). Statistical: >=66% of curves over Q satisfy the rank part (Bhargava-Skinner-Zhang) — a density statement, not per-curve. Rank >=2: deeply open; Heegner-point machinery degenerates (torsion) and no effective geometric mechanism exists. Three distinct trap axes: per-curve vs statistical, rank part vs exact formula, rank<=1 vs rank>=2.
verification_source: DR 00157; ladder consistent with model prior; primary fetch deferred

attestation.upgrade_path: fetch BSTW supersingular p-part paper + BSZ 66% paper -> A3

name: ABC_IUT_PUBLISHED_BUT_UNACCEPTED
false_form: The abc conjecture was proven by Mochizuki (journal-published, therefore settled) / the abc conjecture is ordinary-open (no serious claimed proof exists) / Scholze-Stix formally refuted IUT to community consensus that the matter is closed.
true_form: CONTESTED-CLAIM anchor, PUBLISHED-BUT-UNACCEPTED variant: Mochizuki's IUT papers claiming abc WERE published (PRIMS, March 2021 — a journal at his own institute) yet the community majority does NOT accept the proof; Scholze-Stix (2018) identified the critical gap at Corollary 3.12, Mochizuki rejects their reading, and no reconciliation exists. Joshi's 2024 preprint series claims a bridge/salvage and is itself unresolved. Journal publication is not community acceptance — this severs a heuristic models rely on. Status verb: CLAIMED-CONTESTED (published). abc itself: open by community standard.
citation: Mochizuki IUT I-IV, PRIMS 2021; Scholze-Stix 2018 rebuttal; Joshi 2024 preprints; per DR 00180
verification_source: DR 00180; fully consistent with model prior on the IUT controversy; primary fetch deferred
